mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 7.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically leads to reduced corporate earnings growth and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE rises above 7.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are rising (m/m > 0.5%), or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL year-over-year change > 2.5%), the Federal Reserve's anticipated tightening of monetary policy leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL year-over-year change exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 95.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 0.5% signals immediate strength in the housing market, which is a leading indicator for consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST rises above 0.5% (m/m), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly growth rate in real GDP (GDPC1) above 2.0% signals sustained economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0% (q/q), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a robust labor market, which supports consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.03.
